_analysis_workers_comment: Optional. Processes for audio analysis. Omit for three quarters of the cores. Analysis is CPU-bound; measured scaling flattens past about 12 workers.
_similarity_weights_comment: Optional. Relative influence of each feature group in Find Similar. Groups are normalised by size first, so these are real weights rather than a side effect of how many columns a group has. 0 removes a group; 2 doubles its say. Adjustable live from the Find Similar window. Groups: timbre = instrument and texture — solo vs ensemble; register = high vs low — separates violin from cello; dynamics = how loud, and how much it swells; tempo = pace in BPM; attack = percussiveness and note density; harmony = tonal centre
_database_comment: Optional. Omit this section entirely to use SQLite at db_path.
